title: Debug deep-link contract
description: The parameters of the test-build debug link, mirrored from the registry file (debug-menu-and-test-hooks).

registry.description: Repo path of the registry module that exports DEBUG_LINK_PATH and DEBUG_LINK_PARAMS.

path.description: The route path of the link, equal to DEBUG_LINK_PATH.

params.description: Every parameter the link accepts, by name.

propertyNames.description: screen, params, initial and state are React Navigation's nested-navigation params, never debug-link names.

values.description: The allowed values, in the registry's order.

kind.description: A value kind instead of a list: date (YYYY-MM-DD or real).
